subject: DEC+J paper accepted with minor revisions

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: DEC+J paper accepted with minor revisions
parts:
Hi folks, 

It took awhile, but the paper introducing DEC+J has finally been accepted with minor revisions at Systematic Biology. I am doing the revisions today.  Presumably it will take a few weeks to get processed and go up on Early View, so if anyone needs the paper before that -- e.g., for their own submissions, e.g. to make available to editors/reviewers -- please email me at mat...@nimbios.org, and I will send it once it's revised.

The citation in its current state:

Matzke, Nicholas J. (2014). "Model Selection in Historical Biogeography Reveals that Founder-event Speciation is a Crucial Process in Island Clades." Systematic Biology. Accepted with minor revisions, July 2014.

Cheers!
Nick

PS: Also, I have made a number of updates to PhyloWiki and the example script lately (no changes to the source code in the last week or two though).  This mostly improves organization, and contains notes on statistical model choice, mistakes to avoid, use of fossils, etc. Further updates are on hold until I get the revision out.
